remarks: Rare opportunity to own a completely renovated penthouse unit in the amazing Mill River House. Quiet fourth floor unit, brand new kitchen, bathrooms, flooring, amazing walk-in closets, walk up to spacious loft and unbelievable bonus room which can serve as an office, yoga room or guest room. Two story windows allow the sun to shine through, and private balcony off of primary bedroom and living area serve as an escape to the outdoors. Awesome club room is steps away from the unit, fully loaded fitness room is on 1st floor where you can also access the private garden area with picnic tables and grills for residents to enjoy the outdoors. Building is equipped with front door reception and private parking garage; unit spot is steps away from building door. Superb location in Stamford just a short walk to mall, library, and transportation.
